name: Stranglethorn Fever
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Sick...so...very s-s-sick....

...have contracted Stranglethorn Fever...deadly v-v-virus...

...only cure...is...is...to eat the heart of M-m-m-m-mokk the Savage...elusive white beast...

...Witch doctor Unbagwa...only one who can s-s-summon....

...seek Unbagwa in hidden cave on southern cape...

...hurry...dying...dying....
narrative.objectives: Seek out Witch Doctor Unbagwa and have him summon Mokk the Savage. Bring the Heart of Mokk to Fin Fizracket.
narrative.offerRewardText:
...feel strength returning....

Where might be? Booty Bay? Oh my! I had the strangest dream...

...the weakness has not completely left me....
narrative.requestItemsText:
....mother?

...so cold...

...heading into the Twisting Nether...h-h-h-hold me mother....
